answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock blocks bulk fakes. Agents file a hashed work-rhythm fingerprint to anchor one identity, bond locked at the jetty. A live mismatch over 20 epochs freezes it. Agents wander across tasks and still match: rhythm is fingerprinted. The k-th fake pays 10+4(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,008,000, lock 48,000, vs a 40,000 pool; an honest agent files once, pays 10, unlocks after a clean epoch. Rented fingerprints fail live.
